title: UN Commission finding on sexual and gender-based violence as a method of war
summary: The Commission assessed the frequency, prevalence and severity of sexual and gender-based crimes across the Occupied Palestinian Territory.
claim: The Commission concluded that sexual and gender-based violence was increasingly used as a method of war by Israel to destabilize, dominate, oppress and destroy the Palestinian people.
legal_characterization: UN Commission finding based on a documented pattern that included acts it characterized as war crimes and crimes against humanity; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: “More than a human can bear”: Israel’s systematic use of sexual, reproductive and other forms of gender-based violence since 7 October 2023
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 223 of A/HRC/58/CRP.6. The record reproduces the Commission's institutional conclusion and does not convert it into a court finding or a finding of individual criminal liability.
